summary.en: Gives the Saʿd ibn al-Rabīʿ report as the reason for revelation. Sets the three steps in order: admonish, then leave her bed (up to a month), then a strike «لا يشين جارحة ولا يكسر عضواً». Reads «فلا تبغوا عليهن سبيلا» as a ban on looking for excuses to harm her once she obeys, and the closing names as a warning to anyone who would lord it over another.
